"use client"

import { cn } from "cn"
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"
import {
  Pagination,
  PaginationContent,
  PaginationItem,
  PaginationLink,
  PaginationNext,
  PaginationPrevious
} from "@/components/ui/pagination"

const PaginationWithSecondaryButtonDemo = () => {
  return (
    <Pagination>
      <PaginationContent>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationPrevious href="#" />
        </PaginationItem>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationLink href="#">1</PaginationLink>
        </PaginationItem>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationLink
            className={cn(
              "border-none! shadow-none! hover:text-secondary-foreground!",
              buttonVariants({
                variant: "secondary",
                size: "icon"
              })
            )}
            href="#"
            isActive
          >
            2
          </PaginationLink>
        </PaginationItem>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationLink href="#">3</PaginationLink>
        </PaginationItem>
        <PaginationItem>
          <PaginationNext href="#" />
        </PaginationItem>
      </PaginationContent>
    </Pagination>
  )
}

export default PaginationWithSecondaryButtonDemo
